archetype.profile: Brand new sub. Friendly but cautious about money. Will engage in small talk, asks normal questions, may buy a low-priced PPV if pitched at the right moment.

transcript.text: hey just subbed love your vibe whats your fav thing to do for fun?
watching thunderstorms from my balcony with some old r&b blasting. lowkey obsessed 😏
that sounds relaxing af. im a hike and chill kinda guy. what r&b you blasting?
summer walker mostly, her vibes just melt with the thunder. jhene aiko when im feeling extra chill 🖤
summer walker hits different for sure. jhene aiko got that chill energy i vibe with on hikes.
yea her voice just floats, perfect for getting lost in nature like u do. makes me wanna try a hike with that soundtrack
yea hiking with jhene in the background would be epic. you ever been on a real trail?
ive done a couple trails around austin, nothing crazy but they get my heart racing
austin trails sound dope ive never been there. what gets your heart racing the most on em?
the steep climbs that make you sweat, or when the path gets all narrow and wild. lowkey thrilling
sweaty climbs get me too. narrow paths add that thrill. you got a fav trail in austin?
barton creek greenbelt for sure, those waterfalls and hidden spots feel like a secret escape
barton creek sounds amazing with waterfalls and all. gotta add that to my list if i ever hit austin. hidden spots are the best part
